name: History Uncle

dm_funnel.dm_text:
Here is the link, as promised: https://historyuncle.substack.com

Every week I publish one long essay on the patterns history keeps repeating. Free to read.

schedule.note: The always-on Tick job creates a draft on draft_days (0=Sunday) at draft_hour_local:draft_minute_local. Approved drafts are handled per publish_mode.

_publish_mode_note: manual: approving sends ready-to-post slides and caption to Telegram. auto: approving schedules a post through the Instagram API (needs IG_ACCESS_TOKEN).
